title: SOURDOUGH REHYDRATION — sporeGate is a dried sporePrint, add water and it grows

the_metaphor.sporePrint: sporeGate has been locked/frozen since ~wave 144. 295,806 files, 76GB of ancient bones. ALL 18 primals, fossilRecord, detroit, wateringHole, hypothesis, whitePaper. It IS the organism in dried form.
the_metaphor.sourdough: A sourdough starter can survive dried for YEARS. Add water (fresh data), flour (new commits), warmth (Forgejo sync), and it starts GROWING again. The ancient yeast (compiled primals) is still alive in the plasmidBin.
the_metaphor.rehydration: Fresh clone from Forgejo (1.4GB, latest commits) + ancient bones (.bak, 76GB) + Pixel injection (655MB wateringHole) = the organism springs back to life.
the_metaphor.cursor_is_the_way_out: Cursor/VSCode on sporeGate (or via RustDesk) is the OUTPUT CHANNEL. The organism processes internally, Cursor articulates externally.

contents.compiled_binaries: skunkBat target/release present, likely others too

pixel_journey.at_sporegate: Pixel USB → ADB push → inject wateringHole into fresh clone → ancient bones + fresh water + wateringHole = FULL ORGANISM
